description: This Java class defines a custom file filter for ECU image files used in the RomRaider project. It extends `FileFilter` and wraps a generic file filter to accept files with specific extensions (.bin, .hex) and provides a description for use in file chooser dialogs.

classes.name: ECUImageFilter
classes.description: A Java class extending `FileFilter` to accept specific ECU image files (.bin, .hex) for file selection dialogs.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether the given file is accepted by this filter, delegating to the internal `GenericFileFilter` instance.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a description string for this file filter, delegating to the internal `GenericFileFilter`.
